job went well no problems

details.description: Every thing went good
Everything ran great
Did great job

While checking the pumps and performing an oil change, I noticed that one of the pumps had an oil leak. I proceeded to clean up the spilled oil, then installed a cover and power-washed the unit to ensure it was thoroughly clean.
While doing walk around l noticed a cap missing on ground rod off of light plant
While running casing the driller didn't float his link tilt out enough before coming up, catching the collar in the stump and lifting the FMS along with the string.
When picking up a joint to long for the laydown machine. They tried tailing in the joint by hand.

Running Casing, making up casing joint, Driller trying to stick CRT in to casing joint, but we don't know how CRT dies got engaged, stop the Driller and told hem, we have to lay down the joint we just make up, that way he can disengage CRT in the stomp
Return hose to the flush mount was busted and leaking.
First joint the tail rope was on the top side of the pipe, driller started coming up with the pipe.
When we made up the hanger it was higher than 4 feet to bite the tongs
Drummer leaving Ibop open while running casing instead of closing it
Brought water and food to casing crew
Floors were extremely slippery from the oil base
Notice, fitting on hose(FMS) connected to control panel was leaking
Un cable se enredaba en el equipo de torque torn y en el spring de los clinchers
Load wasnt properly secured.

When driller would fill pipe with top drive he would fill it to where it would shoot out everywhere causing mud to get all over tail rope causing possible chanve of rope slipping out of hands and possibility of joint flying and hurting someone
Slip and trips on the rugs put over a elevated peace of the floor
Welder needed someone to help him back up
Bolt broke on pba tong hold shift lever just need bolt replace still working good
WHILE CHECKING POWER UNIT THAT CAME FROM A JOB NOTICE HYDRALIC FLUID WAS LOW
When picking up fms with lay down line need to have more then one spotter

we need some tool lanyard for the lift nubbin bars to tie off the bar while using it since patterson are not allowed or us to use sashcord because it has no rating atleast 6ft or more to be used to turn the nubbin
Cut work operator couldn't communicate well, otherwise the work went on well and successful
Before leaving the shop or leaving the rig,pushers and those tasked to drive to check the unit or the trailer if all the tools are tied up or secured good.We almost dropped some tools on the way
Driller forgot his set points and slammed the elavators into the fms and shot the bails out sideways.
Missing keeper on floor base on ODS .

recent_findings.positive: Good casing run. The crew was all wearing proper PPE. They used good communication with each other and the rig crew and were mindful of the hazards around them

recent_findings.concern: Leaving tools in the work area creating potential trip hazards. Issue was resolved. Walking behind the tongs while casing was being made up. Discussion was held.
recent_findings.positive: Great teamwork while working 3 man floors. Fkirenwas clean and organized. Great job.

recent_findings.concern: Other than the observation listed above I didn't notice any other issues or concerns which hand and body placement it pinch points.
recent_findings.positive: Rene did a great job of keeping his hands outside of the lift nubbings while removing them before each connection. He also utilized his tong stand as a table to place the nubbings rather than using the ST-80. Great job.

recent_findings.concern: Hand placement was good as well as body positioning during running operations.
recent_findings.positive: Only flaw observed was the tong operator and casing crew hand both giving hand signals at the same time to the driller in which way to move the bails. This was on the second joint and corrected before the third joint was ran.

recent_findings.concern: SSE needs to do a better job of staying with his mentor and vice versa. I discussed this with them. As far as body positioning, hand placement and pinch points I didn't note any issues.
recent_findings.positive: Mike Gonzalez held a very thorough safety meeting covering all necessary tasks and requirements for the casing run. He made the rig crew aware of our SSE and his length of time and experience in the oilfield. Great job.

recent_findings.concern: As stated above, I noticed a crew member not stepping back out of the swing radius of the tongs after they were pulled onto the casing. I also observed crew members wearing hoodies. Had a discussion with them about Butch's policy for hoodies.
recent_findings.positive: Crew members were taking the time between connections to pressure wash and clean the floor and equipment while joints were drilled down. Great job.
